skills.name: Train_Prep
skills.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "prepare training materials", "create training for [industry/client]", "制作培训材料", "准备培训", "给客户做培训方案", "Train_Prep", or wants to generate a consulting deliverable package (Word report + interactive HTML slides) for a specific industry/client. Involves multi-agent parallel research, pain point analysis, AI solution mapping, Word report generation, and interactive HTML presentation creation.

第 3 步：并行启动 3 个研究 Agent

核心架构约束（多 Agent 接口契约）
